text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Running through the Japan Dirt Derby made 
it clear. Umamusume are cute and precious. 
The reason why is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Because they're always giving it their 
all! Passionately chasing their dreams! I 
want to become someone who can stand 
alongside Opera O-san and Doto-san like 
that too...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll run in that same race King-san 
entered last year alongside the senior 
ladies to sharpen my resolve! Next time: 
《Off to the Mile CS!》 Stay tuned☆
